title: discobox-review card
description: The meat of a change: a few bullets of what changed, and the places in the diff that are its core. Leave tests, comments, documentation and mechanical edits that only follow from another change out of core; the reviewer reads the core first and the rest after.

at.description: When the card was written, RFC 3339. card set fills it in.

commit.description: The commit the line numbers were taken at. card set fills in HEAD.

base.description: The commit to review the change from, as a hash, not a ref: where the work the card describes begins. A ref moves; the card's line numbers do not. card set expands it to the full hash.

summary.description: What changed, a short bullet each.

core.description: The places in the diff that are the core of the change, most important first.

items.description: path#L12-L20, path#L12, or path; path?side=old#L4-L9 for lines the change removed.
